svg.title: A square root halves the angle

cc:Work.dc:title: A square root halves the angle
cc:Work.dc:description: For real kx in a lossless medium, kz² lies on the real axis: 0° for propagation, 180° for evanescence. Taking its square root halves the angle, placing the chosen root on a first-quadrant boundary (0° or 90°), with −kz opposite. Examples: 0.75→0.866 and −1.25→1.118i.
